reason: Blocked A gives the clearest restriction and deliberate correction path, with explicit focus restoration. Birthday B offers the strongest focused editor and keeps its important actions visible at 200%. Neither reaches the requested threshold: browser recovery, validation and persistence evidence is incomplete, and several components remain below 9.
limitations: Read-only review used only attached images, checks.json and expansion-19.html. No prior ratings, other graders, implementation or delegation.

Component vectors use hierarchy, typography/spacing, surfaces/color, clarity, feedback/recovery, accessibility. Null means feedback is inapplicable to static content or cannot meaningfully be graded for an unimplemented component behavior; it is not a zero. Screen feedback grades reflect only available state, navigation and study-status evidence.
Each screen score combines normal and 200% evidence; enlargement problems are retained rather than averaged away. A and F use unrounded dimension means for the overall calculation.

checks.json records twelve prototype/size combinations without overflow. It contains no action/result traces, baseline checks, error-state captures, contrast measurements or assistive-technology results. Additional baseline and interaction coverage is user-supplied evidence, not independently reproduced here.

Prototype save/check actions announce that no data changed. Birthday Back, Cancel and Forget lack handlers; date validation and persistence are absent. These are scoped prototype boundaries, not demonstrated successful product behavior or automatic hard-gate failures. Shipping them as working controls would materially change the assessment.

No inaccessible primary action or data-loss gate is established by these images. Below-fold content alone does not prove an unreachable action. Input underline visibility and numeric-keyboard punctuation access need browser verification.
The separate correction view is supplied at both sizes only for blocked A. Expanded disclosures, focus appearance, empty/error/loading states and post-action layout are not pictured.

Physical iPhone, VoiceOver and native behavior remain separate unverified gates. Scores are provisional browser/design judgments; they do not certify native 9/10 quality or transfer baseline eligibility protections to candidates.
